faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

0.question: How long does a typical project take?
0.answer: Depends on scope. Landing pages: 1-2 weeks. Full-stack apps or migrations: 3-6 weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after our initial consultation.

1.question: What's included in the fixed price?
1.answer: Everything needed to ship: design, development, deployment, SEO setup, and post-launch support. No surprise invoices, no hidden fees.

2.question: How much does a project cost?
2.answer: Landing pages start at EUR 1,000, migrations and SEO work from EUR 1,500, MVPs from EUR 5,000, full-stack apps from EUR 7,500. Every project gets a custom quote after a free consultation.

3.question: Do I own the code?
3.answer: Yes, 100%. You get the full source code, repository access, and deployment setup. It's yours to maintain, extend, or hand off to another team.

4.question: Which technologies do you use?
4.answer: Our core stack is Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and PostgreSQL. For AI we use Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI, and Anthropic. Deployed on Vercel with monitoring via Sentry and PostHog.

5.question: Can you improve my existing site's performance?
5.answer: Yes. Our SEO & Performance service includes technical audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, and implementation. Most sites see significant improvement within 1-2 weeks.

6.question: I have an idea but no product yet. Can you help?
6.answer: That's our MVP Development service. We help scope features, design the UI, and build a working product in 3-5 weeks - ready for real users and investor demos.

7.question: When does a retainer make sense?
7.answer: When you need continuous development - new features, iterations, performance work, or reliable on-call support. Retainers start at EUR 2,500/month with priority support. Cancel anytime.

8.question: Not sure where to start?
8.answer: Book a free 30-minute call. We'll assess your situation and recommend the best starting point - whether that's a landing page, an SEO audit, a migration, or something else entirely.

results.projectedHint: Estimated performance after we rebuild your site with Next.js
results.webVitalsSubtitle: These metrics directly affect how users experience your site and how Google ranks it.

vitalExplanations.FCP: First Contentful Paint - how quickly visitors see the first content. A slow FCP means users stare at a blank screen and are more likely to leave before your page even appears.
vitalExplanations.LCP: Largest Contentful Paint - when the main content becomes visible. If this takes longer than 2.5 seconds, roughly half of mobile visitors will leave before seeing your message.
vitalExplanations.TBT: Total Blocking Time - how long the page is unresponsive to clicks and taps. High blocking time means frustrated users who tap buttons and nothing happens.
vitalExplanations.CLS: Cumulative Layout Shift - how much the page layout jumps around while loading. Shifting content causes users to accidentally click the wrong thing, damaging trust.
vitalExplanations.SI: Speed Index - how quickly the visible area of your page is populated. A slow Speed Index means your site feels sluggish even if it eventually loads.
vitalExplanations.default: This metric affects how users perceive your site's speed and responsiveness.
